Issues | Congressman Michael McCaul Skip to main content Issues Border Security As the Chairman Emeritus of the Homeland Security Committee and a lifelong Texan, I am committed to securing America's borders. I recently joined with my Texas Republican colleagues to introduce a border security plan. Together, we are working to put an end to the border crisis Texans are facing each day. Economy Under President Biden's Administration, inflation skyrocketed. Republicans, including myself, are committed to making meaningful spending cuts in this new term to fight inflation and lower the cost of living for every day Americans. Energy Texas leads the nation in the production of both conventional and renewable energy sources, providing nearly a quarter of all US energy. Since coming to congress, I have supported and helped create policy that prioritizes American-made energy, reduces dependence on foreign oil, and brings jobs back to central Texas. Foreign Affairs American leadership on the global stage is critical. At the beginning of the 118th Congress, I became the first Texan to ever chair the Foreign Affairs Committee, which dates all the way back to the Continental Congress. This committee is responsible for oversight of State Department policy and promoting a responsible legislative agenda that bolsters international engagement with our allies, counters the aggressive policies of our adversaries, and advances the common interests of nations in defense of stability and democracy around the globe. Health Care Health care reform must ensure that quality coverage is affordable and accessible for every American, regardless of income or pre-existing conditions. Energy | Congressman Michael McCaul Skip to main content Energy Texas leads the nation in the production of both conventional and renewable energy sources, providing nearly a quarter of all US energy. Since coming to congress, I have supported and helped create policy that prioritizes American-made energy, reduces dependence on foreign oil, and brings jobs back to central Texas. America’s national security and economic prosperity depend on the continued growth of economically viable sources of energy, and Texas can lead the way. During the 118th Congress, I voted for H.R. 1, the Lower Energy Costs Act , to increase domestic energy production, reform the permitting process, and reverse the Biden administration's anti-energy policies. We must unleash American energy in Texas and across the nation to strengthen our national security and ensure Americans can afford to fill their gas tanks. Economy | Congressman Michael McCaul Skip to main content Economy Under President Biden's Administration, inflation skyrocketed.  Republicans, including myself, are committed to making meaningful spending cuts in this new term to fight inflation and lower the cost of living for every day Americans. We are also working to unleash American energy — bringing gas prices down across the nation — and strengthen our supply chains by encouraging American production. In the 118th Congress, I voted for H.R. 1, the Lower Energy Costs Act , to tackle the energy crisis and bring inflation down. I also sponsored the TCJA Permanency Act , legislation to keep more money in Americans' wallets by making permanent the tax cuts for families and small businesses enacted in 2017. Inflation is a tax on all Americans. I will continue working to ensure taxpayers' hard-earned dollars are spent wisely and cast votes in favor of economic opportunity and American job growth. Veterans | Congressman Michael McCaul Skip to main content Veterans As the proud son of a WWII B-17 bombardier, I am inspired and awestruck by the service of our men and women in uniform. These brave patriots who defend our Constitution, values, and freedoms deserve the very best in healthcare, education, and financial assistance. We owe them each a debt of gratitude for their sacrifice and should ensure we are always doing everything we can to support them, including reforming our Department of Veterans Affairs. They deserve nothing less. During my time in Congress, I have voted for pay increases for the military, bonuses for service members, and made permanent a temporary program to pay military widows and widowers. I have also co-sponsored legislation to issue grants assisting veterans pursuing higher education, housing stipends for individuals affected by extended school closures due to natural disasters, and for the VA to provide in-patient psychiatric care for certain veterans. I remain committed to working tirelessly on behalf of our veterans who risked their lives to keep us safe. Border Security | Congressman Michael McCaul Skip to main content Border Security As the Chairman Emeritus of the Homeland Security Committee and a lifelong Texan, I am committed to securing America's borders. After President Biden rescinded Trump-era policies that secured our border, illegal border crossings rose to record highs. Our border agents are now dealing with thousands of crossings each day, increased cartel activity, drug smuggling, and more. Fentanyl-related deaths have also risen to record highs, killing thousands of young Americans.  In the 118th Congress, I joined with my Texas Republican colleagues to introduce a border security plan. Together, we are working to put an end to the border crisis Texans are facing each day.  I also voted in support of the Secure the Border Act , which contained my provision to compel the Biden administration to bring back Remain in Mexico, a policy that successfully worked to keep migrants in Mexico while awaiting their asylum hearings. I am committed to continuing this work to secure our borders and protect our national security. High Tech and Semiconductors | Congressman Michael McCaul Skip to main content High Tech and Semiconductors High Tech Caucus Business is the engine of America’s economy and the High Tech sector is the engine of America’s innovation. Shortly after I was first elected to the United States House, I formed the Congressional High Tech Caucus. Our goal is to find ways to keep America’s tech sector strong and provide our domestic industry with the support it needs to remain on the cutting edge. Bringing together the best and brightest minds in the high tech sector generates the ideas that create high paying jobs and allows us to become a more efficient and competitive nation. Semiconductor Chips During the 117th Congress, my CHIPS for America Act was signed into law. I wrote this bill after President Trump's national security team came to me in 2020, recognizing the vulnerability of our dependence on foreign manufacturers and supply chains. Right now, Taiwan produces 90 percent of all advanced semiconductors chips, and the threat of a Communist China takeover of Taiwan is real. Semiconductors are the brains behind everything from your cell phone to the advanced weapons systems that keep our nation safe. That makes them an integral part of our daily life – and the backbone of America's national security. This bill will bring thousands of jobs to Texas and help bolster U.S. national security for years to come!
